title: See which days a team was busy

version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]

## Work stops on Sundays

These illustrative commit counts give each day a square, Monday at the top and one column for each week. A day with no row is an empty outline, not a zero, and the key under the chart names both.

```chart
type: calendar
title: Commits come in bursts and stop on Sundays
subtitle: Commits per day, 10 February to 20 March 2025
data:
  inline:
    - {day: 2025-02-10, commits: 3}
    - {day: 2025-02-11, commits: 8}
    - {day: 2025-02-12, commits: 1}
```

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each day's commits.
